design.step1: Re-fetch and compare all 12 canonical official source full normalized OHLC/VOL/value hashes; halt any revised official source before D1 SQL
design.step2: Every official source market+date sorted 4-digit stock key is compared with isolated System2 Hot D1 RAW entries in bounded 10..50-symbol indexed IN batches (default 50)
design.revisionRule: Duplicate RAW physical rows on same source-key are MULTIVERSION_BLOCKED, never opportunistically choose favorable version
design.sourceValueRule: Compare open/high/low/close/volumeShares/tradeValue/transactions with source values; classify missing/multi/mismatch per exact symbol-day
design.coverageResultRule: PASS_ALL_11843_SOURCE_KEYS_MATCH_D1_VALUES_ONLY is direction source->D1, NOT absence proof of D1-only extra records, historical clock or PIT eligibility

recommendedFollowup: Run 36-key scout first on confirmed read budget; if mostly absent avoid the 240-query census until controlled date-scoped missing-key repair is budgeted. If scout mostly matched, run this full census before any full-market 2026/10/08 storage-complete announcement.
